books.title_suggestion: Queen: Note-for-Note Keyboard Transcriptions (Hal Leonard, HL00141589)
books.identification_note: The exact 13-song list (Bohemian Rhapsody, Death on Two Legs, Don't Stop Me Now, Good Old-Fashioned Lover Boy, Killer Queen, Lazing on a Sunday Afternoon, Love of My Life, Nevermore, Play the Game, Seven Seas of Rhye, Somebody to Love, We Are the Champions, You're My Best Friend) matches Hal Leonard's 'Queen: Note-for-Note Keyboard Transcriptions' (00141589) exactly. These are advanced note-for-note keyboard transcriptions from the original recordings.
